components.gap: Two results the source states in its main text are not proved under the source's exact hypotheses. (1) On p.64 the source says 26^{iota'}, 26^{iota''}, ... are consequences of Axioms 1-6^alpha and 8. The handbook's derivation uses Axioms 1-8, bringing in Axiom 7 through 28 and 27^iota, and it explicitly leaves the 1-6 + 8 claim unsettled (040 body lines 489-500). (2) On p.59 the source says the same-type predecessor P_{alpha'alpha'} cannot be defined without descriptions, as a consequence of the independence of the axiom of infinity. The handbook reports this as an unproved source claim (041 body lines 617-632) and gives no proof. Every other stated theorem and derived rule has a written proof.
